feat: add Consumable Catalog (platform + App Studio) (#147)

* feat(mercury): add consumable catalog schema

Introduce platform/App consumable tables, soft selections, purchase entries,
permissions, and storage orphan allowlist without seeding material types.

* feat(mercury): add consumable catalog service

Implement ownership, categories, translations, device bindings, purchase
matching, CAS revision, and soft select/deselect with App isolation.

* feat(mercury): add consumable asset lifecycle

Add upload intents, finalize validation, detach-on-replace, and orphan
cleanup for consumable cover/background/mask/gallery assets.

* feat(mercury): expose consumable catalog APIs

Register platform and App Studio Huma routes for consumables, categories,
selections, and upload intents with permission metadata.

* feat(vega): add shared consumable workspace

Add the single ConsumableWorkspacePage with editor sections and thin
Platform/App adapters so both surfaces share one business UI.

* feat(vega): integrate consumable navigation and access

Wire Platform and App Studio routes, sidebar entries, permission gates,
and localized consumable catalog copy.

* test(consumables): cover catalog workflows

Lock shared workspace behavior, capability derivation, reserved regions,
and selection revision handling with unit tests.

* fix(consumables): reclaim unconsumed finalized uploads

Expire finalized-but-unconsumed upload intents in cleanup and reuse
finalized intent IDs on save retry so failed creates do not leak objects.
